codec: lupi-codec profile port · BGR555 · indexed sprites
audioCompatibility: Audio files are copied byte-for-byte. WAV headers are checked, but WAV variants, MP3 and OGG support must be confirmed against the target console firmware.
alphaConversion: Bayer 4x4 ordered coverage dithering to preserve semitransparent shadows in the 1-bit transparent index.
verification: Static package validation only; not a measurement of console RAM or a physical-console run.
